testbenches.name: Steam Machine · 32 GB DDR5-5600
testbenches.notes: Valve's Steam Machine (6-core Zen 4) upgraded from the stock 1x16 GB to 2x16 GB SO-DIMMs. Only its own GPU (steam_machine_8gb_valve) runs on it. Its RAM can be swapped, so a different RAM setup gets a new bench rather than an edit to this one.
